mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), a supply shock reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in real retail sales (RSAFS) relative to the prior month indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with RSAFS growth above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
